question: Who among the following athletes was the first ever youth ambassador of United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund (UNICEF) India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hima Das.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hima Das**__

 __
 
• Hima Das is associated with** track and field in athletics.**
 
• She is from the state of **Assam.**
 
• She is also known as the **Dhing Express.**
 
• She is also appointed as a Deputy Superintendent Of Police (DSP) in Assam Police.
 
• She participates in events like 100m, 200m and 400m. She won Gold in the 2018 Jakarta Asian Games.
 
• She also won the Arjuna Award in 2018.
 
• Hima Das became the first Indian woman deed the first-ever Indian athlete to win a gold medal in any format of a global track event at IAAF World U20 Championships when she clocked a speed of 51.46 seconds.
 
• She was appointed as the first-ever Youth Ambassador by UNICEF India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UNICEF**__

 
 
• UNICEF- **(United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund / United Nations Children's Fund).**
 
• It was created by **United Nations General Assembly on 11 Dec 1946. **
 
• It is the successor of the **International Children's Emergency Fund (ICEF)** which was created in** 1946 by the U.N. Relief Rehabilitation** Administration with the prime objective of providing immediate relief to children and mothers affected by World War II.
 
• The primary objective of the agency is to provide humanitarian development aid to children worldwide.
 
• **UNICEF** is having more than **150 country offices** across the globe & has a presence in **192 countries & Territories.**
 
• **President **- Tore Hattram **(As of March 2022)**.
